items.title: Execute agent-liveness child smokes with bounded concurrency
items.context: Replace the seven-child serial loop with a small fixed concurrency pool while preserving child marker recursion prevention, inherited output, exit/signal failure propagation, and completion of started children.

items.title: Prove the bounded runner bites and restores cold full-suite headroom
items.context: Add focused regression coverage for concurrency bounds and child failure semantics, then verify a cold build plus canonical root npm test remains below the unchanged 120-second member and 300-second suite budgets.
